tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: A company or partnership firm or sole proprietorship or registered under the Company Act 1956 or Companies Act 2013
Any other documents as per tender document
Company registration of trading or business from the municipality or corporation. The Company office should be located at Bengaluru for correspondence
GST certificate copy along with latest GST returns filed for 3 months copy should be enclosed
Income tax returns of last Five years with profit and loss balance sheet and PAN number
Notarized copy of self-declaration for not blacklisted on Rs. 500/- non-judicial bond paper
The firm should have been empaneled by RBI or IBA as security printer
The firm should have supplied similar type of item
The tenderer should furnish the information on all past supplies and satisfactory performance for both a and b above, in proforma under Section XII
